source.method: Same fixed1925 edition. Initial PDF61,67,68,104,105 visual reading preceded implementation; literal PDF68 quotations rechecked at3x after implementation, with old transcription and separate erratum retained. Digital transcription is a locator, not the oracle.

clauses.quote: 爻臨日建月沖不破月尅無傷
clauses.scope: A same-branch current day gives the stated exception to the month-only opposition; not a blanket exemption from all other controllers.

clauses.quote: 假使爻中又動出申酉之金或卯爻動化申酉
clauses.scope: Retain independent moving control and own transformed back-control. Do not invent a numeric controller threshold or vote.
additional_quotes: 酉月卯日占卦爻臨卯木謂之逢破不破
寡不敵衆破亦為破傷亦為傷

clauses.quote: 目下雖破出月則不破今日雖破實破之日則不破逢合之日則不破近應日遠應年月
clauses.scope: Current exact day-value branch only in this round; future relief and calendar combinations remain separate.

clauses.quote: 動則能傷於爻變則能傷於動
clauses.scope: Month-break position alone cannot certify permanent incapacity or a harmless changed controller.

interpretation.raw_preservation: Retain original month_strength category, branch_facts and raw role atom values. Add separately sourced present-day qualifications.
interpretation.known_branch: Only raw month opposition plus the very same current day branch. Day generation, day combination, peer branch and a future day are not this exact exception.
interpretation.other_harm: Additional moving/dark control, binding, void, back-control, penalty and weak target gates remain independently visible; unresolved activity is never false.
interpretation.changed_scope: Actual own changed branch only; no imagined static changed line or cross-position changed support. Base actors do not attack a changed branch.
interpretation.hidden_scope: Use the hidden or flying branch itself, never its counterpart. A day-valued flying month-break is not automatically released as weak.
interpretation.no_global_result: No total strong/weak or actual emergence/outcome is inferred by counting supporters or from a local calendar exception.

scope: Current same-day value vs raw month opposition, with independent control counterexamples; not full month-break time-domain or full-book arbitration.
